end.summary:
Top/bottom and on/under were practised with 5 questions; 4 unaided answers were correct. A new-situation or “why” check is still needed.
Inside/outside was practised with 2 questions; 1 answer was unaided correct, so the distinction is not steady yet.
Near/far was practised by comparing with a reference; the comparison method is still building.
The mix-up between “on top of” and “inside” was seen once and was not corrected after the last time it appeared.
end.parentNote: Shaurya practised position words by answering picture-like prompts and comparing one object with another. They used “neeche” correctly in several direct questions and noticed that a fish in water is not outside the water; the on-top/inside mix-up still needs checking, and near/far needs more comparison practice. At home, place a toy on, under, inside, and outside a box, then ask “Where is it?” and “Why?”
